assignments.title: Greeks, volatility and hedging

canonical_spec.title: Greeks, volatility and hedging
canonical_spec.outcome: Analyze hedge sensitivities and the implications of changing volatility assumptions.

assignments.state: queued; not dispatched until middle-batch publication finishes
assignments.prerequisite_and_scope_contract: Use c08 funded dividend-adjusted vanilla price/PDE and c07 Ito only within their proved scope. Derive delta, gamma, vega and calendar theta, units/scaling and portfolio signs; distinguish partial fixed-parameter Greek from total calibrated-surface response. Derive Taylor exposure with controlled local remainder and a genuinely financed discrete hedge ledger. Explain continuous volatility-mismatch P&L under stated actual diffusion assumptions and fixed pricing sigma, not a universal discrete realized-variance identity. Prove implied-volatility monotonicity with vega and identify strict price bounds/existence/uniqueness and ill-conditioning at boundaries; solve with a bounded reliable bracket. Develop smiles/skews and elementary strike monotonicity/convexity diagnostics without claiming any arbitrary volatility smile defines a no-arbitrage process. At least3 substantial cases/10 original solved exercises incl proof and model/research critique. Portable original inputs/output, independent finite differences and hedge/economic interventions; explicit small-tau/zero-vega domains. Do not preteach unproved general stochastic-volatility pricing or tree convergence.

assignments.prerequisite_and_scope_contract: Use c06 finite tree/optimal stopping, c07 Gaussian/GBM and numerical moment limits, c08 PDE/vanilla anchors, and agreed c09 sensitivities/implied-volatility inversion. Teach implementation and error analysis of recombining binomial trees, finite differences, Monte Carlo and variance reduction with distinct approximation/discretization, truncation, sampling and floating errors. Prove a substantive convergence/stability/error result for the declared scheme, e.g. a finite-difference maximum principle plus consistency under explicit regularity, rather than asserting convergence from a table. Distinguish exercise-grid convergence from changed market dynamics; prove finite Snell recursion already supported. MC mean/variance and CLT/Hoeffding scope; original standard-library reproducible generator/seed with analytical moments, antithetic or fixed/pilot control variate derivation and independent evaluation. For regression early exercise explain training/evaluation separation and feasible-policy lower-bound direction; no full algorithm proof unless actually supplied. Original full lab bounded runtime normal/-O, reliable numerical oracle, at least3 examples/10 solved grad prompts; no dependencies or giant simulated datasets.
